title: BR-004: consent is channel-and-purpose scoped, not global
risk: A marketing grant for one channel is reused for another, or a transactional message is blocked by a marketing opt-out, breaking either privacy or deliverability.

steps.action: Inspect the consent lookups recorded per probe

assertions: Consent is resolved per (customer, channel, purpose); a wildcard positive grant is never inferred from an absent record.
